column1: 21823§atmosphere§ˈætməsfɪə(r)§Uranus' atmosphere consists largely of hydrogen and helium.§天王星的**大气**主要由氢和氦组成。§
21824§appoint§əˈpɔɪnt§He is appointed to administer funds.§他被**指派**去管理基金。§
21825§characteristic§ˌkærəktəˈrɪstɪk§Many characteristics, such as height and intelligence, result not from the action of genes alone.§诸如身高、智力等这些**特征**并不完全是基因作用的结果。§
21826§identify§aɪˈdentɪfaɪ§In 1986, American researchers identified the genetic defect underlying one type of muscular dystrophy.§1986年，一些美国研究人员**发现**了可导致某种肌肉萎缩症的遗传缺陷。§
21827§altitude§ˈæltɪtjuːd§One common type of coffee bean, called Robusta, is grown at altitudes below 600 metres.§罗布斯塔咖啡豆是常见的一种咖啡豆，生长在**海拔**600米以下的地方。§
21828§possess§pəˈzes§My professor possessed a surrealistic canvas by Dali.§我的教授**拥有**一幅达利的超现实主义油画。§
21829§excitement§ɪkˈsaɪtmənt§The excitement died down.§**激动**的情绪已经平息了。§
21830§contradiction§ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkʃn§It is a contradiction that what you said just now is not consistent with what you said one year before.§你刚说的话与一年前说的话不符，真是**自相矛盾**。§
21831§painstaking§ˈpeɪnzteɪkɪŋ§It is a painstaking task of interpretation, so that we come to understand what these things mean for the human story.§诠释工作需要**非常细心**，这样我们才能了解这些事情对人类历史意味着什么。§
21832§pursuit§pəˈsjuːt§Archaeology is both a physical activity out in the field and an intellectual pursuit in the study or laboratory.§考古学既是一种野外的体力活动，也是研究室或实验室里的知性**探索**。§
21833§humanistic§ˌhjuːməˈnɪstɪk§The point is to shock the viewer, brushing aside the humanistic nature of classical photography.§似乎一切的重点都是为了震惊观者，而无视经典摄影艺术**人文关怀**的本质。§

21834§coherent§kəʊˈhɪərənt§The archaeologist has to develop a picture of the past, just as the scientist has to develop a coherent view of the natural world.§考古学家需要提供一张过去的图片，就如同科学家需要描绘出自然世界的**连贯**图景。§
21835§outlook§ˈaʊtlʊk§The highly respected old man has a fairly positive outlook on life.§这位德高望重的老人对待生活的**态度**非常乐观。§改译文：原译文没译出 outlook，加「的态度」
21836§apportion§əˈpɔːʃn§We apportion the money before valuing the price of the souvenir.§在对纪念品估价之前，我们先**分配**一下花销。§
21837§finitude§ˈfaɪnɪtjuːd§It is far beyond human finitude to climb this mountain.§攀登这座山远远超出人类的**极限**。§
21838§exhaustible§ɪgˈzɔːstəbl§Stone, brick, metal and plastic are all derived from exhaustible mineral sources.§石料、砖、金属和塑料都是从**可耗尽**矿产资源中提取的。§
21839§revelation§ˌrevəˈleɪʃn§The revelation of the commercial secrets would bring legal punishment to this multinational enterprise.§**泄露**商业机密将使这家跨国公司受到法律制裁。§
21840§resistance§rɪˈzɪstəns§The defenders put up strong resistance to the demonstrators.§防卫者采取强硬的措施来**阻止**示威游行者。§
21841§attainable§əˈteɪnəbl§The newly set standard is easily attainable by most students.§大部分学生可以轻松地**达到**新标准。§
21842§indispensable§ˌɪndɪˈspensəbl§A good reference book is indispensable for learning a classwork.§一本好的参考书对于学习一门功课是**必需**的。§
21843§cuisine§kwɪˈziːn§I would choose Chinese cuisine compared with French cuisine.§比起法国餐，我更喜欢中**餐**。§
21844§reputable§ˈrepjətəbl§I insured my property and my health with a reputable insurance company.§我在一家**著名**的保险公司购买了财产及健康保险。§
21845§overshadow§ˌəʊvəˈʃædəʊ§News of the severe accident overshadowed the whole day's events.§那场严重的交通事故使得一整天的新闻都**显得无足轻重**了。§
21846§unparalleled§ʌnˈpærəleld§It was an unparalleled opportunity for Mary to develop her studies.§这对于玛丽发展学业来说是一个**绝好**的机会。§
21847§opulence§ˈɒpjələns§The lecture hall was decorated with stagy opulence.§演讲大厅装点着**丰富**的舞台装饰。§
21848§supersede§ˌsuːpəˈsiːd§The old theory has been superseded by more recent research.§旧的理论已经被较新的研究**取代**了。§
21849§exploitation§ˌeksplɔɪˈteɪʃn§There is a report on the exploitation of child workers which attracts broad attention.§有一篇关于**剥削**童工的报道引起广泛的关注。§
21850§passionate§ˈpæʃənət§People in the primitive tribe have a passionate nature.§原始部落里的人**富有激情**。§
21851§poisonous§ˈpɔɪzənəs§They ate a species of poisonous mushroom.§他们吃了一种**有毒**的蘑菇。§
21852§strip§strɪp§Topsoils are stripped and stockpiled prior to mining for subsequent dispersal over rehabilitated areas.§在采矿前先将地表土层**挖去**并贮存起来，用于之后铺在矿区需要恢复的地区。§
21853§exhaust§ɪgˈzɔːst§She was exhausted by her four kids.§四个孩子让她**筋疲力尽**。§
21854§mysterious§mɪˈstɪəriəs§Writers transport their heroes to mysterious realms beyond the Earth.§作家们将其笔下的英雄带到地球之外的**神秘**地域。§
21855§spite§spaɪt§He put the house up for sale out of spite at his family.§他将房子出售是出于对家人的**怨恨**。§
21856§passport§ˈpɑːspɔːt§This country is working to stop the illegal sale of its passports to suspected terrorists.§这一国家正在阻止向有恐怖分子嫌疑的人非法出售该国**护照**。§
21857§divert§daɪˈvɜːt§Out of a country's health budget, a large proportion should be diverted from treatment to health education.§在一个国家的医疗预算中，大部分费用应从治疗**转移**到健康教育上。§

21858§dissemination§dɪˌsemɪˈneɪʃn§Whether the activity is tourism research, business, or data dissemination, the lack of a common language can severely impede progress.§不管是旅游研究、贸易还是资料的**传播**，缺少一种共同的语言都会严重阻碍这些活动的发展。§
21859§perpetual§pəˈpetʃuəl§Life itself was a perpetual and punishing search for food.§生活本身就是一个**不断**辛苦找寻食物的过程。§
21860§contradict§ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt§The statement contradicts the writer's views.§这一陈述与作者的观点**不符**。§
21861§organize§ˈɔːɡənaɪz§Classes are organized according to ability level.§根据能力水平进行**分**班。§
21862§column§ˈkɒləm§My friend has his own column in the magazine.§我朋友在该杂志上有自己的**专栏**。§
21863§source§sɔːs§We understand a port as a centre of land-sea exchange, and as a major source of livelihood and a major force for cultural mixing.§我们把港口看作海陆交换的中心、生计的主要**来源**以及推动文化融合的重要力量。§
21864§cater§ˈkeɪtə(r)§The role of tourism is to cater to the needs of the tourists in accordance with their class.§旅游业就是一个**满足**各阶层人士旅游需求的行业。§
21865§lobby§ˈlɒbi§They were lobbying for stronger environmental protection.§他们在为加强环境保护而进行**游说**。§
21866§flexible§ˈfleksəbl§Cars easily surpass trains or buses as a flexible and convenient mode of personal transport.§小汽车轻易地超越火车和公共汽车，成为一种**灵活**、便利的个人交通工具。§
21867§penalty§ˈpenəlti§People who work reduced hours pay a huge penalty in career terms.§缩短工作时间的人事业上会遭到严重**损失**。§
21868§comply§kəmˈplaɪ§The patient was unwilling to comply with the physician's orders.§这位病人不愿意**遵从**医生的嘱咐。§
21869§capsule§ˈkæpsjuːl§A capsule is long and thin, and you can open it up and take out what's in it.§**胶囊**通常长而薄，你可以把它打开，把里面的东西倒出来。§
21870§aeronautics§ˌeərəˈnɔːtɪks§The Aeronautics Building is on the left side of the university campus.§**航空学**大楼位于校园的左侧。§
21871§adopt§əˈdɒpt§After becoming independent of the local authority and adopting its new title, our college continued to build on its first class reputation.§自从我们学院脱离当地部门并**改**了新名之后，就一直致力于打造一所一流院校。§
21872§lease§liːs§Could I ask how long the lease is?§我能问一下**租期**是多久？§改例句：间接疑问句要用陈述语序，how long is the lease 改 how long the lease is；改译文：句末缺问号
21873§bit§bɪt§Hot coffee is a bit hard to carry.§热咖啡**有点**不好拿。§
21874§conceal§kənˈsiːl§Men were very aware that thieves might be concealed behind the car.§人对窃贼可能**藏**在车后很警觉。§

21875§compromise§ˈkɒmprəmaɪz§This means that the choice you make will probably be determined by the amount of money you want to pay, your own personal needs, what is actually available or a compromise of all three things.§这意味着你所做的选择可能会取决于你想花多少钱、你的个人需要和你实际能买到的（商品），或者你也可以将三者**折中**一下。§
21876§haphazard§hæpˈhæzəd§There are books piled on shelves in a haphazard fashion.§书架上**无序**地堆放着一些书。§
21877§essential§ɪˈsenʃl§It is essential that the glass be thicker on the outside than on the inside.§外层的玻璃应该比内层的玻璃厚，这一点**很重要**。§
21878§urge§ɜːdʒ§My boss urged me to unfold my market strategy.§老板**鼓励**我详细阐述我的市场策略。§
21879§feasible§ˈfiːzəbl§Better integration of transport systems is made more feasible by modern computers.§现代计算机的应用使得交通系统**有可能**得到更好的统筹。§改译文：原译文没译出 feasible，加「有可能」
21880§cereal§ˈsɪəriəl§The east of the UK is its great cereal-producing region.§英国东部地区是英国最大的产**谷**区。§

21881§existence§ɪgˈzɪstəns§There are no scientists in existence who really wait until they have all the evidence in front of them before they try to work out what it might possibly mean.§**世上**从来没有哪个科学家真的要等到所有的证据都摆在他面前才试图研究可能的规律。§改译文：原译文没译出 in existence，加「世上」
21882§apply§əˈplaɪ§If you would like more information on how to apply for a student loan, then you should contact The Student Loans Company.§如果你想获得更多有关**申请**学生贷款的信息，那么你应该和学生贷款公司联系。§
21883§admission§ədˈmɪʃn§If you have any questions, please contact the Admissions & Information Office.§如果你有任何问题，请与**招生**信息办公室联系。§改例句：& 后缺空格
21884§attempt§əˈtempt§A series of lectures organised by the Students' Union is part of the union's attempt to help students stay healthy.§学生会举办的一系列讲座是为帮助学生保持健康而**努力**做的事情之一。§
21885§inference§ˈɪnfərəns§If the evidence is true then by inference he is guilty.§如果证据确凿，就可以**推断**出他有罪。§
21886§loop§luːp§These tunnels must loop around and connect.§这些隧道一定是**成环状**的，而且是相通的。§
21887§subtract§səbˈtrækt§That event subtracts nothing from his merit.§那件事丝毫没有**减损**他的美德。§
21888§linguistic§lɪŋˈgwɪstɪk§Industrial training schemes have promoted an increase in linguistic and cultural awareness.§工业培训计划促进了**语言**和文化认知的进步。§
21889§aptitude§ˈæptɪtjuːd§Each branch of this company had employees of comparable aptitudes.§该公司的所有分公司都雇用**能力**相当的员工。§
21890§premier§ˈpremiə(r)§The premier was injured in a bomb attack.§**总理**在一次炸弹袭击中受伤。§
21891§enquiry§ɪnˈkwaɪəri§The library staff answered every enquiry from new students about borrowing books and using the computers.§图书馆工作人员回答了新生关于借书和使用电脑的每一个**询问**。§补例句
